tips.text: Rank Cronus to 30 before you sell it; the guaranteed drop replaces a sold one, but selling early costs a rebuild for the last Mastery levels.
Run Tolstoj solo or host the squad; joiners get no blueprint.
Rerun Vor if the blueprint orb shows already collected and nothing arrived.
Treat Cronus as Mastery fodder: craft it, rank it, sell it.
